summary: Form is a short form, set up as a project brief by default, with a Draft with agent button that fills the fields in for the person. Fields the agent filled carry a Drafted mark beside their label until the person edits them, so it is clear what still needs a human read. On submit every field is checked, and a confirmation replaces the form once it goes through.
use: When an agent can fill in a brief, ticket or request from context and a person should review it
When people need to see which answers they typed and which the agent wrote
When a short form needs inline messages per field instead of a page of errors
When creating something should hand off to the agent, as in "the agent is gathering references now"
features: Fields can be text, textarea or `choice`, a row of chips that picks one value.
A `maxLength` on a text field shows a live counter like 0/40 and stops typing there.
Passing `onDraft` adds the Draft with agent button, which shows Drafting and then Drafted while your promise runs.
Text fields that change while the draft runs are marked Drafted until the person edits them; choice fields are not marked.
Each field's `validate` runs on submit, shows its message under the field, and clears as soon as the value changes.
If `onSubmit` returns a promise, the button spins until it settles; a rejection shows its message, and success shows the done screen.
a11y: Field messages render with `role="alert"`, and invalid inputs set `aria-invalid`.
Choice chips sit in a `group` labelled with the field name, and each chip reports `aria-pressed`.
The Drafted mark beside a label is `aria-hidden`, so it is not read into the field's name.

faq.q: How does the agent fill in the fields?
faq.a: Control the form with `values` and `onValuesChange`, and update the values inside your `onDraft` promise. Any text field that changes while the draft runs gets the Drafted mark.

faq.q: Can I start the agent's draft without a click?
faq.a: Yes. Put a ref on the form and call `ref.current.draft()`. It runs `onDraft` with the same Drafting and Drafted states as the button.

faq.q: How do I validate a field against another field?
faq.a: `validate` receives the field's value and all the form's values. Return a message string to block the submit, or a falsy value to let it pass.
